canonical_title: Anthropic previews Model Hardware Standard for AI agents operating physical devices
treatment: Treat the initial MHS research preview as covered. Reinclude for open-source release, published specification changes, named production deployments, safety evaluation results, or material device/network-control changes.
known_facts: Anthropic opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard to an initial group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.
MHS is intended to let AI agents safely operate multiple programmable physical devices such as microscopes, liquid handlers and robotic arms, including across networks.
Anthropic is sharing the early version with partners for safety evaluations before an intended open-source release.
reinclude_only_if: Anthropic publishes the MHS specification or open-sources the implementation.
Named labs or manufacturers disclose production deployments or reproducible results.
Safety evaluations materially change the design, permissions model or network-control architecture.
notes: NEW in the 2026-08-28 Midday window; official Anthropic research preview plus Reuters coverage.
